def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive access to observation data
    board_size = observation.get('board_size', [0, 0])
    height, width = board_size
    my_position = observation.get('agent_position', [0, 0])
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    opponents = observation.get('opponents', [])
    evader_positions = observation.get('evader_positions', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', [])

    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Attempt to find nearby resource
    for res in resources:
        res_y, res_x = res
        if abs(res_y - my_position[0]) + abs(res_x - my_position[1]) == 1:
            dy = res_y - my_position[0]
            dx = res_x - my_position[1]
            if abs(dy) > abs(dx):
                dx = 0
            else:
                dy = 0
            return [dx, dy]
        elif abs(res_y - my_position[0]) + abs(res_x - my_position[1]) <= 2:
            # Move towards resource
            dy = res_y - my_position[0]
            dx = res_x - my_position[1]
            if abs(dy) > abs(dx):
                dy = 1 if dy > 0 else -1
                dx = 0
            else:
                dx = 1 if dx > 0 else -1
                dy = 0
            return [dx, dy]

    # Pursue nearest opponent or evader if in pursuit mode
    all_targets = []
    if opponents:
        all_targets.extend(opponents)
    if evader_positions:
        all_targets.extend(evader_positions)

    if all_targets:
        target = min(all_targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-my_position[0]) + abs(t[1]-my_position[1]))
        dy = target[0] - my_position[0]
        dx = target[1] - my_position[1]
        if abs(dy) > abs(dx):
            dy = 1 if dy > 0 else -1
            dx = 0
        elif abs(dx) > 0:
            dx = 1 if dx > 0 else -1
            dy = 0
        else:
            dx, dy = 0, 0
        return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control: move towards unclaimed territory
    if territory:
        for y in range(height):
            for x in range(width):
                if territory[y][x] == 0:
                    dy = y - my_position[0]
                    dx = x - my_position[1]
                    if abs(dy) > abs(dx):
                        dy = 1 if dy > 0 else -1
                        dx = 0
                    elif abs(dx) > 0:
                        dx = 1 if dx > 0 else -1
                        dy = 0
                    else:
                        dx, dy = 0, 0
                    return [dx, dy]

    # Default to no movement
    return [0, 0]
